sources.title: Notes from Sidney Coleman's Physics 253a: Quantum Field Theory

evidence.text: An isolated late example introduces J(x)φ²(x)/2 to calculate a composite-operator insertion at O(g²), combines denominators with Feynman parameters, shifts loop momentum and applies on-shell spinor identities; the supplied calculation stops at a parameter integral.

sources.title: Causal quantum gravity

evidence.text: A nilpotent gauge charge defines graded variations. Gauge invariance is imposed inductively as d_Q T_n equal to divergences of products with one Q-vertex; local anomalies are tested for cancellation by local normalization terms.

sources.title: Notes from Sidney Coleman's Physics 253a: Quantum Field Theory

evidence.text: Fourier-mode construction and inversion connect creation/annihilation distributions to fields. Euler–Lagrange equations, the Hamiltonian formulation and canonical equal-time commutators provide a second construction.

sources.title: Notes from Sidney Coleman's Physics 253a: Quantum Field Theory

evidence.text: Interaction-picture perturbation theory uses Dyson time ordering, free-field Wick contractions, diagram symmetry numbers and factorization into connected components.

sources.title: Causal quantum gravity

evidence.text: Epstein–Glaser induction constructs time-ordered operator-valued distributions by Wick expansion and retarded/advanced splitting of causal numerical distributions. Nonnegative singular order requires subtracted dispersion integrals and permits local derivative-of-delta normalization terms.

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at finite temperature in scalar QED

sources.title: Don’t throw the baby out with the bath water

evidence.text: What classical correspondence requirements should constrain quantum gravity, can a flat-background perturbative S-matrix supply an adequate definition, and might the apparent ultraviolet failure of general relativity instead reflect limitations of conventional perturbation theory?

sources.title: UV complete me: Positivity Bounds for Particles with Spin

evidence.text: Rotate helicity states into transversity states using a unitary Wigner D matrix that diagonalizes the crossing Wigner matrices. Use helicity partial waves, their positive absorptive matrix, Fourier expansions of Wigner matrices, and Chebyshev-polynomial derivatives to establish signs.

sources.title: The EFT-Hedron

evidence.text: Fixed-t dispersion relations and contour deformation express sufficiently subtracted EFT coefficients through massive pole residues and cut discontinuities. Positive partial-wave expansions use Gegenbauer polynomials for scalars and Wigner/Jacobi structures for four-dimensional helicity states.

sources.title: Rigorous bounds on light-by-light scattering

evidence.text: Use normalized positive measures and convex-hull geometry for analytic bounds, and SDPB optimization of positive functionals for numerical bounds involving several coefficient ratios.

sources.title: Positivity bounds in vector theories

evidence.text: A Stückelberg decomposition separates helicity-0 and helicity-1 modes. The limit m→0, Λ2→∞ with Λ3=(mΛ2²)^(1/3) fixed identifies scalar Galileon and scalar-vector mixing interactions.

sources.title: Bounds on photon scattering

evidence.text: Positive cones of weakly coupled scalar, axion, spin-two and QED-like amplitudes identify unbounded directions. Adjustable masses allow independent positive combinations at dimension 8 and dimension 10, or dimension 8 and dimension 12.

sources.title: Positivity in the renormalization of effective field theory

evidence.text: Supplemental calculations include explicit SMEFT RG combinations, UV matching examples and finite-radius dispersive contour integrals within the EFT regime. The contour analysis explains why positivity of an amplitude-derived arc need not imply positivity of an individual dimension-eight coefficient.

evidence.text: Can calculable infrared Standard Model photon–graviton scattering constrain ultraviolet gravitational amplitudes through gravitational positivity bounds, thereby reversing their usual interpretation as constraints on EFT coefficients?

sources.title: To Positivity and Beyond, where Higgs-Dilaton Inflation has never gone before

evidence.text: Do forward-amplitude positivity and improved positivity constrain the first higher-derivative Wilson coefficients of Higgs-Dilaton inflation strongly enough to conflict with its phenomenological parameter region?

sources.title: Positivity bounds for scalar field theories

evidence.text: Which positivity conditions must a massive scalar EFT satisfy if it admits a local, analytic, unitary, Poincaré-invariant UV completion, including away from forward scattering? Can these conditions also bound the mass threshold of additional states?
